protocol.purpose: New independent A2 MSIC confirmation, only the already locked two rules; no confirmation parameter selection

budget.policy: All stages share one persisted start, failures/budget stop forbid adoption and resume; no truncation or rescue

bootstrap.unit: Paired dataset resampling within frozen scenarios; report primary70/stress10 separately and pooled80 fixed gate

protocol.interpretation: Fresh original-MSIC A2 library fit for each new dataset; fixed library rescoring is mathematically identical for full grid because global alpha/scale do not control initialization, adaptive mode scores, or fixed fits. Three uncached public alpha2/scale0 fresh refits required to verify equivalence. Truth and test only evaluate after training selection.
